info.title: EdgeBalancer API
info.description: Control plane for deploying Cloudflare Worker load balancers and API gateways. All responses follow { success, data, message } format. Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset) are included on every response. API versioning: current version is v1. Deprecation will be signaled via Sunset header.

cookieAuth.name: token
cookieAuth.description: JWT httpOnly cookie set by POST /api/auth/google

get.description: Kubernetes readiness probe. Returns 200 when the service is ready to accept traffic.
Kubernetes liveness probe. Returns 200 when the service process is alive.

post.description: Exchange a Firebase ID token for a JWT cookie. If 2FA is enabled, returns totpRequired/twoFactorRequired instead of setting the session cookie.
Clear the current session cookie and any 2FA challenge cookies.

get.description: Return the authenticated user's profile including subscription tier and Cloudflare connection status.

post.description: Generate a new TOTP device secret and QR code. The device is not active until confirmed with /2fa/confirm.

200.description: Device enrollment data with otpauthUrl and qrDataUrl

post.description: Verify a TOTP code to activate a newly enrolled device.
Remove a TOTP device. Requires a code from a different confirmed device (or the last device's own code).
Exchange a TOTP code + 2FA challenge cookie for a session cookie. This is the second step of login when 2FA is enabled.
Generate WebAuthn credential creation options for enrolling a new passkey.
Verify the WebAuthn registration response and store the passkey.
Generate WebAuthn credential request options for passkey login. Requires the 2FA challenge cookie.
Verify the WebAuthn authentication response and set the session cookie.
Remove a registered passkey by its credential ID.
Rename a TOTP device or passkey. The name is user-chosen and displayed in the 2FA settings UI.
Set which 2FA method the login flow opens on (totp, passkey, or null for auto).
Store Cloudflare account ID and API token. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted before MongoDB write.

put.description: Update the stored Cloudflare account ID and API token.

get.description: Return the stored Cloudflare credentials with the API token masked (last 4 chars visible).
List all Cloudflare zones (domains) in the connected account.
Initiate Cloudflare OAuth to connect a Cloudflare account.
Cloudflare OAuth callback handler. Processes the authorization code and stores credentials.

post.description: Disconnect the Cloudflare OAuth connection and clear stored credentials.

get.description: List all load balancers for the authenticated user. Returns an array of LoadBalancer objects.

post.description: Create a new load balancer. Validates hostname availability, deploys a Worker to the user's Cloudflare account, attaches the domain, and stores the config in MongoDB.

get.description: Return analytics data for all load balancers in a single request.
Return a single load balancer by ID.

put.description: Update a load balancer. Uses Cloudflare Worker Versions and Deployments for zero-downtime updates. Rolls back on failure.

delete.description: Delete a load balancer. Removes the Cloudflare Worker and detaches the domain.

post.description: Check if a hostname (domain + subdomain + name) is available before creating a load balancer.
Cancel a running create or update operation. Triggers rollback of any partial changes.
Pause a load balancer. release-domain detaches the domain; keep-domain keeps it but serves a maintenance page.
Resume a paused load balancer. Re-attaches the domain and re-resolves origin IPs.

get.description: Return request/error analytics for a specific load balancer.
DNS-resolve all origin URLs to their IP addresses.

post.description: Reset the health check state for all origins of a load balancer, forcing immediate re-evaluation.

get.description: List all API gateways for the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new API gateway with JWT, caching, canary, IP rules, rate limiting, header transforms, mock routes, path routing, and/or CORS.

get.description: Return a single gateway by ID.

put.description: Update a gateway configuration. Uses Worker Versions for zero-downtime updates.

delete.description: Delete a gateway. Removes the Cloudflare Worker and detaches the domain.

post.description: Check if a gateway hostname is available before creating.
Pause a gateway.
Resume a paused gateway.

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of deployment history sessions. Filter by all, active, or inactive.
Return the raw Worker JavaScript source code for a session.

post.description: Send a natural language prompt to the AI agent. Returns an SSE stream with events: run_start, model_active, model_switch, status, tool_start, tool_result, done, error. Rate limit: 30 requests/15min per user.

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of AI agent run history.
Return a single AI run with full execution steps.

post.description: Create a Cashfree checkout session for a plan upgrade.
Cashfree payment webhook. Verified by HMAC signature. No authentication required.
Create a discounted upgrade order from one plan to another.
Verify the status of a payment order. Used by jitter polling on the client.

get.description: Return the user's payment history.
Return public platform metrics scaled x10. Cached in Redis for 2 hours.
Canonical path for public stats. Same as GET /api/stats.
Return the authenticated user's full profile.
